title: Unit 14 Review: Environment & Climate Policy
goal: Consolidate future-perfect targets, policy-scenario conditionals, passive se agreement, technical attribution and neuter lo.

items: I can express climate targets and estimates with *futuro perfecto*.
I can model environmental policy proposals with *si* + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional.
I can apply accurate passive *se* agreement and formal source attribution in environmental prose.
I can summarise policy priorities with neuter *lo* + adjectives and past participles.
